name: ClassBench
intro: ClassBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文发布的 1,000 个合成环境之一，表示“音乐学校排课与考勤”场景；它包含由 AWM 流水线生成的任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具和验证逻辑。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 任务成功奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强验证
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；每个场景生成10个任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented verification
intro_en: ClassBench is not a standalone benchmark; it is one of 1,000 synthetic environments released by the Agent World Model paper, representing Music School Scheduling and Attendance with generated tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, and verification logic.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 tasks are generated per scenario
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10090v3, especially Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, execution-based self-correction, and Appendix Table 15. The paper does not define ClassBench as a standalone benchmark: Table 15 identifies it as the generated scenario ‘Music School Scheduling & Attendance’ within AgentWorldModel-1K. AWM expands domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenarios, filters and deduplicates them, creates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario, generates a task-conditioned SQLite schema and initial data, exposes a minimal typed Python toolset through MCP, and builds task-specific verification from initial/final database-state differences plus an LLM judge. Each component is executed in isolation and failures are self-corrected for up to five attempts before release. The diagram therefore documents the ClassBench environment’s disclosed AWM synthesis and evaluation path while explicitly preventing its misclassification as an independent benchmark.
